given.note: A receipt for a chat no thread holds: only S1-01's commit writes a number's chat thread (open gap 48), so a reply to someone whose first text wrote none, such as Dee W.'s, lands on a chat id this database does not know (linq-chat-demo-dee, an example). Both fields are null: the adapter answers receiptHandleUnknown, the gateway answers 503 and Linq retries (QUESTIONS.md CQ-61), so the receipt is never placed on a guessed handle. Nothing is written.
